rationale: C22 plausibly supplied a concrete policy and organizational template for the child. It requests recommendations for operational communications satellites and specifies global service, attention to developing nations, public-interest objectives, ownership and operation, use of public and private resources, international cooperation, and coordination among responsible agencies. The child presents proposed legislation organized around substantially the same distinctive cluster of objectives and machinery. C07 and C08 are weaker parallels as Kennedy legislative-transmittal letters explaining a proposed entity and interagency coordination, but they concern different programs and mostly share genre-level structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the assurance of global coverage; cooperation with other countries; ... the provision of service to economically less developed countries
shared_material.parent_excerpt: serve the rapidly expanding communications needs of this and other nations on a global basis, giving particular attention to ... newly developing nations throughout the world
shared_material.explanation: Both articulate the same distinctive geographic and international-service objectives for a communications-satellite system.

shared_material.child_excerpt: particular attention has been given to the question of the ownership of the entity that will operate this system
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Policy proposals should include recommendations ... as to the nature and diversity of ownership and operation of communications systems and parts thereof
shared_material.explanation: The child's detailed ownership design directly develops the ownership-and-operation question assigned in C22.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a subject which, by nature, is essentially private enterprise in character but of vital importance to both our national and international interests and policies
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Effective utilization of both our public and private resources needs to be assured, as well as close cooperation with other countries and their communications systems.
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C22's public-private and international-cooperation framework into the justification for a privately owned, federally chartered corporation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: because of the existing overlapping of responsibilities and interests, it seeks to define and identify these responsibilities and expressly assign them in an orderly fashion
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Continuing coordination of the governmental agencies responsible for regulatory, space, military, and other aspects of this field is essential.
shared_material.explanation: Both identify the same cross-agency coordination problem spanning regulatory, space, and other governmental responsibilities.
